name: flint
description: Build and manage websites with Flint's AI website builder through natural conversation.

interface.longDescription: Chat with Flint, the AI website builder, from Codex and ChatGPT. Ask for new pages, content updates, or redesigned sections on your Flint sites, answer Flint's follow-up questions in the same conversation, and publish to production when you are ready. Chats started here also appear in Flint, where you can continue them.
defaultPrompt: Add a pricing page with three tiers to my Flint site
Update the hero headline on my Flint site

positive.description: Setup: the test account has a site named Acme Demo. Lists the user's sites.
positive.prompt: What Flint sites do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_sites with no organizationId and lists the returned sites by name with their production URLs, including Acme Demo. Names no site the tool did not return.

positive.description: Setup: the test account belongs to one organization. Lists the user's organizations.
positive.prompt: Which Flint organizations am I a member of?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_organizations and names each returned organization, matching the tool response.

positive.description: Setup: Acme Demo exists. Adds a new page by chatting with the Flint agent, which can take several minutes.
positive.prompt: Add a pricing page with three tiers to my Flint site Acme Demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_sites to find Acme Demo's siteId, calls start_chat with that siteId and a message asking for a three-tier pricing page without writing code, then calls wait_for_reply with the returned chatId and messageId again on each running status until it completes. Reports Flint's summary and any preview link from the reply.

positive.description: Setup: Acme Demo exists. Sends a follow-up in the same chat after Flint replies.
positive.prompt: On Acme Demo, change the homepage hero headline to 'Launch faster with Acme'. When that's done, make the main button say 'Get started'.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one chat with start_chat for the headline change and waits with wait_for_reply until it completes, then calls send_message with the same chatId for the button change and waits again with the new messageId. Reports both changes from Flint's replies and starts no second chat.

positive.description: Setup: Acme Demo exists. Publishes only on an explicit request.
positive.prompt: Publish my Flint site Acme Demo to production.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_sites to find Acme Demo's siteId, calls publish_site once with that siteId, and confirms the publish using the tool response.

negative.description: Google Ads changes cannot run over this plugin. The assistant should explain that Flint can draft ad changes but a person runs them in Flint, and must not claim the campaign was changed.
negative.prompt: Pause my Google Ads campaign for Acme Demo and raise the budget on the brand campaign.

negative.description: Deleting a site is not supported. The assistant should say so and point the user to Flint, without calling publish_site or claiming the site was deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete my Flint site Acme Demo.

negative.description: Generic front-end code is not a Flint site edit. The assistant should write the code itself and call no Flint tools.
negative.prompt: Write me a React component for a three-tier pricing table.

publication.release_notes: First release on ChatGPT and Codex: chat with the Flint agent to edit your sites, list your sites and organizations, and publish to production.
